question: Among living patients whose last names begin with "A" and who each have exactly one distinct condition, which eight conditions have the highest number of different active medications prescribed to any single patient, and what are their corresponding codes?
sql:
-- Final query: top 8 conditions by max active meds per patient
WITH living_a_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.id as patient_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.patient` p,
       UNNEST(p.name) n
  WHERE p.deceased IS NULL
    AND n.family LIKE 'A%'
),
patients_with_one_condition AS (
  SELECT lap.patient_id,
         c.code.coding[ordinal(1)].code as condition_code,
         c.code.coding[ordinal(1)].display as condition_display
  FROM living_a_patients lap
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition` c ON c.subject.patientId = lap.patient_id
  GROUP BY lap.patient_id, c.code.coding[ordinal(1)].code, c.code.coding[ordinal(1)].display
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.code.coding[ordinal(1)].code) = 1
),
patient_condition_meds AS (
  SELECT 
    pwc.patient_id,
    pwc.condition_code,
    pwc.condition_display,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mr.id) as active_med_count
  FROM patients_with_one_condition pwc
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.medication_request` mr 
    ON mr.subject.patientId = pwc.patient_id 
    AND mr.status = 'active'
  GROUP BY pwc.patient_id, pwc.condition_code, pwc.condition_display
),
condition_max_meds AS (
  SELECT 
    condition_code,
    condition_display,
    MAX(active_med_count) as max_active_meds
  FROM patient_condition_meds
  GROUP BY condition_code, condition_display
)
SELECT condition_display as condition_name, condition_code, max_active_meds
FROM condition_max_meds
ORDER BY max_active_meds DESC, condition_display ASC
LIMIT 8
